title: Capitalize Words
description: This function should capitalize the first letter of every word. It only capitalizes the first letter of the entire string.
instructions: Fix the capitalizeWords function so every word starts with a capital letter.
expected_behavior: 'hello world' → 'Hello World', 'the quick brown fox' → 'The Quick Brown Fox'.
hints: Think about splitting the string into words.
Each word needs to be capitalized individually.
